p_reading.caliber: cumulative return from STARTING equity of the base anchor (not peak-relative); main-reading NAV series navm; window ends = anchor ends (AMENDMENT 2 §1)
p_reading.halt_semantics: at the first window end strictly below the threshold the path stops trading and its NAV is held flat; no manual resume is modelled
granularity: utc_day_ends_only (sensitivity, the live watchdog's daily cadence)
p_reading.note_window_end: breach_by stays 2026-08-31T00:00:00Z (AMENDMENT 2 §2); the 'to_window_end' block runs to 2026-09-18T20:00Z, i.e. through the describe-only extension segment

p2_reading.rule: AMENDMENT 3: after every day-stop flatten the path is withheld until the first anchor >= t + H; withheld anchors earn exactly 0; H = 12 h main, 8/20 h sensitivity, 'sim' = the simulator's next-00Z rule (= published reading P), 'never' = the strict lower bound; §4-4 (cumulative -25 %, no resume) runs at the same time, whichever fires first stops the path
assumptions_named_in_the_amendment: a withheld anchor earns exactly 0 (a flat book): residual dust and its funding are ignored
the book is rebuilt from the target at the resume anchor, which is what the simulator does after any flatten; a different resume time would meet different fills, which is NOT modelled
the flatten cost is the one the simulator actually paid at that flatten and does not vary with H
